description.value: Prata-Man Singapore Cuisine is a fast-food spot in Richmond specializing in Singaporean and Southeast Asian dishes, with Hainanese Chicken — both regular and free-range — as the signature item. The menu also spans roti, Laksa, Mee Goreng, BBQ Satay, and a range of curry dishes, making it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists exploring Richmond's dense food corridor. Online ordering for pickup is available directly through the website.
